jobs.title: Senior Healthcare Data Analyst
jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

The Senior Healthcare Data Analyst is a full-time, senior individual contributor responsible for clinical, outcomes, and program analytics across the organization. Based in the United States, this role partners with clinical, operational, and executive leaders to turn complex questions into clear, meaningful insights.

The position requires an understanding of behavioral health care delivery across the patient journey, including referral, intake, admission, treatment, utilization, outcomes, and discharge. Additionally, this role helps advance AI-enabled analytical methods within the data analysis function, utilizing AI to enhance analytical speed, depth, and efficiency while establishing repeatable processes, independently validating outputs, and ensuring clinical and human oversight.

Key Responsibilities

Analyze access, conversion, census, capacity, utilization, length of stay, patient engagement, clinical outcomes, and program performance.
Develop an understanding of behavioral health care delivery, including intake, treatment planning, group, individual, and family therapy, psychiatry, documentation, authorization, outcomes, and discharge.
Partner with clinical and operational leaders to translate clinical workflows and complex operational questions into meaningful analyses, recommendations, and actionable insights.
Ensure analytical findings reflect actual care delivery workflows and are interpreted within appropriate clinical and operational contexts.
Identify trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities to improve care delivery, patient experience, and program performance.
Partner with clinical and research leaders to define research questions, outcome measures, analytical approaches, and data requirements for clinical studies and program evaluations.
Build accurate, well-documented, and reproducible datasets and analyses for outcomes research, program evaluations, presentations, abstracts, and publications.
Conduct and interpret analyses evaluating patient outcomes, treatment and program effectiveness, and differences across populations, programs, or levels of care.
Translate findings into publication-ready tables, visualizations, summaries, and presentation materials, supporting analytical review through final publication.
Ensure research and publication data and analyses comply with organizational privacy, governance, compliance, and data-use standards.
Serve as an analytics partner to clinical, operational, and executive leadership, establishing and maintaining trusted metric definitions, documentation, analytical standards, and best practices.
Partner with Data Engineering and other analysts to maintain consistent definitions, reliable data, scalable solutions, and standardized dashboards or reporting workflows.
Identify opportunities to improve analytical methods, tools, workflows, and organizational data use while mentoring other analysts.
Apply and advance AI-enabled analytical methods to improve the speed, depth, quality, and efficiency of analytical workflows.
Use AI tools to accelerate data exploration, analytical development, synthesis, and quality review, establishing repeatable prompts, workflows, and standards.
Independently validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, relevance, bias, and context, maintaining human accountability for all final analytical conclusions.
Collaborate with clinical subject matter experts and technology teams to evaluate AI capabilities and integrate them into governed analytical workflows.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Statistics, Information Systems, Healthcare Administration, Health Informatics, Public Health, or a relevant clinical discipline (such as Psychology, Social Work, Counseling, or Nursing), or equivalent relevant experience.
5+ years of experience in analytics, healthcare analytics, business intelligence, or related analytical work. Candidates with a clinical background must also have demonstrated experience using data to evaluate care delivery, patient outcomes, program performance, or other complex healthcare questions.
Experience working with healthcare clinical operations and translating clinical workflows and business questions into meaningful analysis.
Experience analyzing healthcare performance metrics, including access, utilization, quality, outcomes, or program effectiveness.
Experience with modern analytics and business intelligence platforms, such as Power BI.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to independently investigate complex clinical and operational questions.
Demonstrated ability to translate complex data into clear insights for clinical, operational, and executive audiences.
Experience using AI or generative AI to support analytical work, with an understanding of how to validate outputs and manage the risks and limitations of AI-generated analysis.
Strong communication, prioritization, facilitation, and stakeholder partnership skills.
Understanding of healthcare privacy, security, compliance, and the proper handling of protected health information (PHI).

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in behavioral health, intensive outpatient programs (IOP), partial hospitalization programs (PHP), outpatient mental health, substance use treatment, or similar clinical environments.
Familiarity with behavioral health workflows, including intake, treatment planning, therapy, psychiatry, documentation, utilization management, outcomes measurement, and discharge.
Experience with clinical outcomes, program evaluation, or research-related analytics.
Experience working with electronic health records (EHR/EMR) and healthcare operational systems.
Experience incorporating AI-assisted methods into analytical workflows or working with modern cloud data and analytics platforms, such as Microsoft Fabric.

Compensation and Benefits

The expected salary range for this role is $95,000—$112,000 USD
per year. Individual compensation within this range is determined by factors including years of experience, type of experience, work location, education, and relevant certifications.
Eligible positions have access to a competitive benefits package, including:
Health coverage, including medical, dental, and vision plans
Retirement savings plan with company match
Paid time off
Parental leave
Professional development and continuous training opportunities

jobs.title: Research Associate I - Endocrinology - Department of Medicine (Fixed Term)
jobs.description:
Job Description

We invite you consider this rewarding opportunity and apply today!

Principal Investigator, Larissa Langhi Prata, MS, PhD is looking for a Research Associate I to join the team!

About The Team

Dr. Langhi Prata's research investigates the role of senescent cells (SenCs) in the increased susceptibility of older and chronically ill patients to infectious diseases. The research findings may provide valuable insights into the biology of aging and its links to the immune system, allowing the team to develop novel and effective strategies to address infections and sepsis in older adults. To learn more, please visit this website.

About The Role

Please note that this is a fixed term full-time position eligible for benefits. The expected end date will be 1 year from the hire date.

Working under direct supervision, the Research Associate I will perform a variety of routine experimental protocols and procedures to support the objectives of one or more laboratory research projects in a specific area of research. Assists in general laboratory activities, including maintenance of reagents and stocking of supplies. Files and monitors documents. Keeps accurate and detailed records of experiments and results. Assists in the operation of specialized equipment and machinery. Observes and follows safety standards and procedures. The Research Assistant I will be able to perform routine cellular, micro- and molecular biology procedures including, but not limited to Western, Northern blot, DNA/RNA, PCR, protein extraction, cell culture, Immunohistochemistry, and staining. This position does not have supervisory responsibilities.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities:

May assist with animal husbandry.
Maintains lab equipment and related records.
Transports, processes and logs samples.
Maintains computer database with relevant clinical information.
Performs lab maintenance duties, including glassware cleaning and sterilization.
Maintains stocks of general lab materials, and places orders for lab equipment and supplies.
Assists new students and fellows at the laboratory.

Qualifications

Education, Experience, and Skills:

Bachelor's degree in Biological Sciences is required.
Understanding of general research objectives.
Knowledge of routine laboratory procedures and experimental protocols.
Must possess digital literacy.

jobs.title: Research Associate Data Scientist - Ajami Lab - Department of Neurology
jobs.description:
Job Description

Grow your career at Cedars-Sinai!

Data is vital to advance clinical knowledge across a spectrum of medical and surgical fields. Are you ready to transform data discoveries into valuable information, which will empower tomorrow's medicine?

Dr. Bahareh Ajami invites you to consider this Research Associate Data Scientist opportunity to join her dynamic team!

About The Team

The Ajami Lab is establishing a new research program at Cedars-Sinai focused on immune mechanisms driving neuro-degeneration, with a particular emphasis on ALS and microglial biology.

About The Role

The Research Associate Data Scientist participates in biomedical research projects using programming, data -mining, statistics, machine learning, and visualization techniques to assist with the development, evaluation, and/or applications of algorithms, methods, and software for data analysis. Responsibilities include querying databases, data cleaning and quality control, supervised and unsupervised machine learning, parametric and nonparametric statistical methods, deploying production models, and assisting with the communication of scientific findings via peer-reviewed publications and scientific conferences. Writes clean, performant, reusable code managed on GitHub to perform repeatable analyses and to train and deploy models to multiple environments.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities:

Assists with the development, evaluation, and/or application of computational and statistical methods including artificial intelligence and machine learning algorithms and software for the analysis of biomedical data.
Assists with the presentation and communication of scientific results through laboratory meetings, scientific conferences, and peer-reviewed publications.
Creates database-to-deployment pipelines for models using the necessary programming languages (primarily R, Python, SQL, neo4j).
Creates sustainable data science infrastructure and adheres to data analysis/machine learning standards.
Performs data cleaning, quality control, and exploratory data analysis to gauge the need for or appropriateness of advanced analytical methods
Assists research, senior research, and/or lead research data scientists and principal investigators to identify areas where data science can best be applied to answer biomedical research questions.
Tests and validates code to ensure adaptability of data applications with version control through GitHub.

Qualifications

Education:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Applied Mathematics, Biomedical Imaging, Statistics, Engineering, Physics, or related field, required.
Master's degree in these fields is preferred.

Experience and Skills:

Up to two (2) years of professional experience in healthcare or pharmaceutical industries working with biomedical data.
Experience programming at an intermediate skill level with a high-level programming language such as R or Python. College projects may be acceptable.
Experience programming at a basic to intermediate proficiency level in SQL
Experience in biomedical machine learning is preferred.

Analyze access, conversion, census, capacity, utilization, length of stay, patient engagement, clinical outcomes, and program performance.
Develop an understanding of behavioral health care delivery, including intake, treatment planning, group, individual, and family therapy, psychiatry, documentation, authorization, outcomes, and discharge.
Partner with clinical and operational leaders to translate clinical workflows and complex operational questions into meaningful analyses, recommendations, and actionable insights.
Ensure analytical findings reflect actual care delivery workflows and are interpreted within appropriate clinical and operational contexts.
Identify trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities to improve care delivery, patient experience, and program performance.
Partner with clinical and research leaders to define research questions, outcome measures, analytical approaches, and data requirements for clinical studies and program evaluations.
Build accurate, well-documented, and reproducible datasets and analyses for outcomes research, program evaluations, presentations, abstracts, and publications.
Conduct and interpret analyses evaluating patient outcomes, treatment and program effectiveness, and differences across populations, programs, or levels of care.
Translate findings into publication-ready tables, visualizations, summaries, and presentation materials, supporting analytical review through final publication.
Ensure research and publication data and analyses comply with organizational privacy, governance, compliance, and data-use standards.
Serve as an analytics partner to clinical, operational, and executive leadership, establishing and maintaining trusted metric definitions, documentation, analytical standards, and best practices.
Partner with Data Engineering and other analysts to maintain consistent definitions, reliable data, scalable solutions, and standardized dashboards or reporting workflows.
Identify opportunities to improve analytical methods, tools, workflows, and organizational data use while mentoring other analysts.
Apply and advance AI-enabled analytical methods to improve the speed, depth, quality, and efficiency of analytical workflows.
Use AI tools to accelerate data exploration, analytical development, synthesis, and quality review, establishing repeatable prompts, workflows, and standards.
Independently validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, relevance, bias, and context, maintaining human accountability for all final analytical conclusions.
Collaborate with clinical subject matter experts and technology teams to evaluate AI capabilities and integrate them into governed analytical workflows.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Statistics, Information Systems, Healthcare Administration, Health Informatics, Public Health, or a relevant clinical discipline (such as Psychology, Social Work, Counseling, or Nursing), or equivalent relevant experience.
5+ years of experience in analytics, healthcare analytics, business intelligence, or related analytical work. Candidates with a clinical background must also have demonstrated experience using data to evaluate care delivery, patient outcomes, program performance, or other complex healthcare questions.
Experience working with healthcare clinical operations and translating clinical workflows and business questions into meaningful analysis.
Experience analyzing healthcare performance metrics, including access, utilization, quality, outcomes, or program effectiveness.
Experience with modern analytics and business intelligence platforms, such as Power BI.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to independently investigate complex clinical and operational questions.
Demonstrated ability to translate complex data into clear insights for clinical, operational, and executive audiences.
Experience using AI or generative AI to support analytical work, with an understanding of how to validate outputs and manage the risks and limitations of AI-generated analysis.
Strong communication, prioritization, facilitation, and stakeholder partnership skills.
Understanding of healthcare privacy, security, compliance, and the proper handling of protected health information (PHI).

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in behavioral health, intensive outpatient programs (IOP), partial hospitalization programs (PHP), outpatient mental health, substance use treatment, or similar clinical environments.
Familiarity with behavioral health workflows, including intake, treatment planning, therapy, psychiatry, documentation, utilization management, outcomes measurement, and discharge.
Experience with clinical outcomes, program evaluation, or research-related analytics.
Experience working with electronic health records (EHR/EMR) and healthcare operational systems.
Experience incorporating AI-assisted methods into analytical workflows or working with modern cloud data and analytics platforms, such as Microsoft Fabric.

Compensation and Benefits

The expected salary range for this role is $95,000—$112,000 USD
per year. Individual compensation within this range is determined by factors including years of experience, type of experience, work location, education, and relevant certifications.
Eligible positions have access to a competitive benefits package, including:
Health coverage, including medical, dental, and vision plans
Retirement savings plan with company match
Paid time off
Parental leave
Professional development and continuous training opportunities

new_jobs.title: Research Associate I - Endocrinology - Department of Medicine (Fixed Term)
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

We invite you consider this rewarding opportunity and apply today!

Principal Investigator, Larissa Langhi Prata, MS, PhD is looking for a Research Associate I to join the team!

About The Team

Dr. Langhi Prata's research investigates the role of senescent cells (SenCs) in the increased susceptibility of older and chronically ill patients to infectious diseases. The research findings may provide valuable insights into the biology of aging and its links to the immune system, allowing the team to develop novel and effective strategies to address infections and sepsis in older adults. To learn more, please visit this website.

About The Role

Please note that this is a fixed term full-time position eligible for benefits. The expected end date will be 1 year from the hire date.

Working under direct supervision, the Research Associate I will perform a variety of routine experimental protocols and procedures to support the objectives of one or more laboratory research projects in a specific area of research. Assists in general laboratory activities, including maintenance of reagents and stocking of supplies. Files and monitors documents. Keeps accurate and detailed records of experiments and results. Assists in the operation of specialized equipment and machinery. Observes and follows safety standards and procedures. The Research Assistant I will be able to perform routine cellular, micro- and molecular biology procedures including, but not limited to Western, Northern blot, DNA/RNA, PCR, protein extraction, cell culture, Immunohistochemistry, and staining. This position does not have supervisory responsibilities.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities:

May assist with animal husbandry.
Maintains lab equipment and related records.
Transports, processes and logs samples.
Maintains computer database with relevant clinical information.
Performs lab maintenance duties, including glassware cleaning and sterilization.
Maintains stocks of general lab materials, and places orders for lab equipment and supplies.
Assists new students and fellows at the laboratory.

Qualifications

Education, Experience, and Skills:

Bachelor's degree in Biological Sciences is required.
Understanding of general research objectives.
Knowledge of routine laboratory procedures and experimental protocols.
Must possess digital literacy.

new_jobs.title: Research Associate Data Scientist - Ajami Lab - Department of Neurology
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Grow your career at Cedars-Sinai!

Data is vital to advance clinical knowledge across a spectrum of medical and surgical fields. Are you ready to transform data discoveries into valuable information, which will empower tomorrow's medicine?

Dr. Bahareh Ajami invites you to consider this Research Associate Data Scientist opportunity to join her dynamic team!

About The Team

The Ajami Lab is establishing a new research program at Cedars-Sinai focused on immune mechanisms driving neuro-degeneration, with a particular emphasis on ALS and microglial biology.

About The Role

The Research Associate Data Scientist participates in biomedical research projects using programming, data -mining, statistics, machine learning, and visualization techniques to assist with the development, evaluation, and/or applications of algorithms, methods, and software for data analysis. Responsibilities include querying databases, data cleaning and quality control, supervised and unsupervised machine learning, parametric and nonparametric statistical methods, deploying production models, and assisting with the communication of scientific findings via peer-reviewed publications and scientific conferences. Writes clean, performant, reusable code managed on GitHub to perform repeatable analyses and to train and deploy models to multiple environments.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities:

Assists with the development, evaluation, and/or application of computational and statistical methods including artificial intelligence and machine learning algorithms and software for the analysis of biomedical data.
Assists with the presentation and communication of scientific results through laboratory meetings, scientific conferences, and peer-reviewed publications.
Creates database-to-deployment pipelines for models using the necessary programming languages (primarily R, Python, SQL, neo4j).
Creates sustainable data science infrastructure and adheres to data analysis/machine learning standards.
Performs data cleaning, quality control, and exploratory data analysis to gauge the need for or appropriateness of advanced analytical methods
Assists research, senior research, and/or lead research data scientists and principal investigators to identify areas where data science can best be applied to answer biomedical research questions.
Tests and validates code to ensure adaptability of data applications with version control through GitHub.

Qualifications

Education:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Applied Mathematics, Biomedical Imaging, Statistics, Engineering, Physics, or related field, required.
Master's degree in these fields is preferred.

Experience and Skills:

Up to two (2) years of professional experience in healthcare or pharmaceutical industries working with biomedical data.
Experience programming at an intermediate skill level with a high-level programming language such as R or Python. College projects may be acceptable.
Experience programming at a basic to intermediate proficiency level in SQL
Experience in biomedical machine learning is preferred.
